events.title: Beginner Forex Trading Class
events.short_description: Join our Beginner Class and learn the fundamentals of Forex trading from scratch.
events.full_description: Ready to start your trading journey? Join Kiraforex Trading Academy for an intensive live training session tailored specifically for beginners. You will master candlestick reading, currency pair mechanics, trading platform navigation (MT5 & TradingView), position sizing, and how to execute high-probability trade setups with iron-clad risk management.

services.title: Beginners Master Class
